prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production 2D karate sprite sheet, exactly NINE full-body isolated figures in a clean 3 by 3 grid on genuine transparent background. Reference image is ONLY the approved character anatomy, white karate gi, skin shading, crisp ink line and painted 2D sprite rendering style; replace its poses entirely. Subject same adult male, neutral bald featureless blank face, no hair, no eyes/mouth.  Every pose facing screen RIGHT three-quarter side view, unchanged body proportions and same head diameter throughout; each figure entirely inside its cell with clear transparent gutters. Bare feet anatomically correct, hands never feet. Belt, knot and BOTH hanging ends vivid solid magenta marker with light/shadow so isolated belt palette can be compiled; no other magenta. Do not draw labels, cell lines, backdrop, ground, shadows, text, 3D, blurry outlines, particles.
Reading order poses:
1. MUSUBI-DACHI respectful upright attention, feet close, heels touching, arms straight down, open hands by thighs.
2. Start karate REI bow toward right: hinge forward at hips 15 degrees, straight back, arms and hands slide beside thighs, feet together.
3. Full respectful REI bow at hips 30 degrees toward right, straight spine and legs, open hands beside thighs, not praying/not punching.
4. Return to upright attention, feet together, arms down.
5. Transition to YOI: open feet shoulder width, hands relaxed in front of hips, posture upright.
6. YOI HACHIJI-DACHI readiness: feet shoulder width slight turnout, knees soft, TWO closed fists held LOW in front of thighs, elbows relaxed, NOT fists raised to face, not a punch.
7. Transition yoi to fighting kamae: short step into fighting base, raise two bent arms into guard, no attack.
8. Fighting kamae match reference first sprite, both bent arms guard, stable stance.
9. KIBA-DACHI LOW HORSE STANCE: wide symmetric parallel feet planted on ground, both knees bent equally deeply, hips centered between feet, torso upright broad nearly frontal three-quarter view facing right, BOTH fists pulled back tight at their corresponding hips (hikite), elbows bent, no extended arm, no punch, no lunge, not zenkutsu-dachi.
Professional detailed anatomy and clean authored 2D silhouettes, consistent overhead dojo lighting. Nine genuinely distinct poses.
